messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: region=asia-southeast1 service=hosted-api severity=HIGH — elevated 5xx rate and increased latency observed. Trigger: 5xx > 5% for 3m. Paging oncall. #ops :rotating_light:
Priya (sre): I'm on it. Starting triage — checking ingress LB + egress network paths.
Jamal (network): I see a spike in egress errors from nodes in asia-southeast1-a/b. Possible upstream transit flaps. Pulling BGP and peering metrics now.
Carlos (eng-runtime): Can we confirm if this is model-serving or network? CPU/GPU usage healthy on hosts I can query.
Priya (sre): model pods healthy, KV cache hits normal. Errors are HTTP 502/504 at the router layer. Looks like upstream connections timing out.
Jamal (network): Confirmed — packet drops between our colo fabric and ISP X in SG region. MTR traces show intermittent high latency to 203.0.113.45.
ops-oncall (P0): Starting mitigation plan: 1) Shift traffic away from asia-southeast1 to fallback regions for latency-sensitive customers, 2) Update status page, 3) Notify impacted customers.
Priya (sre): Rolling a short-term routing policy override. Using internal control plane: run below (no creds in channel):
```
# temporary traffic steering via redwoodctl
redwoodctl routing update --region asia-southeast1 --policy prefer-fallback --fallback-regions us-west2,eu-west1 --weight 0.0
```
Priya (sre): Applying now. Expect reduced traffic to asia-southeast1 within ~30s.
Carlos (eng-runtime): I pushed a canary to force fallback; logs show requests now landing in us-west2. Latency for those requests ~220ms, acceptable.
Maya (support): Preparing a short customer-facing message. Draft below — please edit: 
"We are currently investigating an elevated error rate affecting requests served from our asia-southeast1 region. We have rerouted traffic to alternate regions (us-west2, eu-west1) to mitigate impact. Teams may see increased latency for affected requests while we resolve the underlying network issue. Root cause under investigation. We will update shortly."
Emma (product): Add note about stored request ordering for streaming customers — some long-lived streams could be restarted; suggest adding: "Clients using streaming/long-lived connections may need to reconnect. We are minimizing disruption."
Priya (sre): Updated draft and posting to status page (internally preview):
Status page draft: 
"Investigating — Asia (asia-southeast1): Users in APAC may experience increased errors and elevated latency due to an upstream network disruption. We have temporarily rerouted new traffic to us-west2 and eu-west1. Live mitigation in progress — engineers engaged. No data loss expected. Next update in 15 minutes."
Priya (sre): Posting update to status.redwood.ai/incidents/xxxxx now.
incident-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATED: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/xxxxx — Investigating (asia-southeast1) — 2025-09-10 04:40 UTC
Jamal (network): Speaking with ISP X NOC; they're seeing a transit issue affecting SG metro POP. ETA unknown. Recommending BGP community advert to avoid affected upstreams.
Carlos (eng-runtime): Suggestion — for Dedicated customers with pinned regions, we should send targeted notification instead of global message. Maya can you split messages?
Maya (support): Yep. I'll create two batches: 1) APAC customers with asia-southeast1 pinned (higher urgency), 2) Global customers (informational). Draft for pinned customers below: 
"We detected a network disruption affecting your requests served from our asia-southeast1 region. We have rerouted traffic to alternate regions and are monitoring to ensure continuity. If you have region-pinned Dedicated capacity, contact support to discuss temporary capacity adjustments or failover options. ETA on fix TBD."
Maya (support): Sending batch 1 now to customers with pinned asia-southeast1.
ops-oncall (P0): Action items checklist: 
- [x] Acknowledge & page (incident-bot)
- [x] Triage & identify network cause (Jamal)
- [x] Temporary traffic steering (Priya/Carlos)
- [x] Status page update (Priya)
- [x] Customer notifications sent (Maya)
- [ ] Work with ISP for restoration (Jamal)
- [ ] Plan permanent mitigation (postmortem)
Priya (sre): Handing off to night oncall in 20 minutes. Leaving recommended next steps in the incident doc: continue monitoring BGP flaps, consider route prepref to avoid ISP X, keep customers updated at 15m cadence until resolved.
pagerduty-bot: On-call handover scheduled: from Priya to Noor at 05:00 UTC.
Priya (sre): Noor — brief: upstream ISP X transit causing drops from SG POP; we've set routing policy prefer-fallback (weight 0) to stop new allocations in asia-southeast1, posted status update, sent pinned-customer notifications. Monitoring logs for reconnect storms.
Noor (oncall): Acknowledged. Will keep 15m updates and escalate to infra if recovery not seen in 60m.
Carlos (eng-runtime): Quick note for runbook: when steering via redwoodctl routing update, follow with: 
```
# validate steering
redwoodctl routing status --region asia-southeast1
kubectl get pods -n hosted-api -o wide --selector=region=asia-southeast1
# check ingress LB health
curl -I https://health-check-hosting/asia-southeast1
```
Jamal (network): ISP reports partial route repairs at 05:10 UTC. We'll monitor for packet loss reappearance.
Priya (sre): Second status update posted: "Mitigation in place — traffic rerouted to fallback regions; ISP reports partial repair. We continue to monitor. Next update in 30 minutes or sooner."
incident-bot: UPDATE POSTED to status.redwood.ai/incidents/xxxxx — Mitigation in place — 2025-09-10 05:15 UTC
Maya (support): Sent follow-up to pinned customers with link to status and recommended steps if they see issues (restart streaming sessions, failover guidance).
ops-oncall (P0): Leaving a final handover note for Noor: keep the steering active until ISP confirms stable routes for 2 consecutive 30m windows; if stable, gradually shift weights back: 0 -> 10 -> 50 -> 100 over 20m intervals. Document in postmortem.
Noor (oncall): Acknowledged. Taking ownership.
Priya (sre): Logging this incident for postmortem. Tags: network, region-asia-southeast1, routing-fallback, customer-notification.
Emma (product): Quick ask — please include affected region list in customer emails: APAC (SG) endpoints: asia-southeast1.
Priya (sre): Noted.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: transitioning to 'monitoring' with assignee Noor — 2025-09-10 05:30 UTC
